description: Defines the data model for in-app notifications including the NotificationItem data class, NotificationType enum, and NotificationDeeplink enum.

classes.name: NotificationItem
classes.description: Domain model for an in-app notification, encapsulating notification details such as id, type, title, message, creation time, read status, and deeplink.

classes.name: NotificationType
classes.description: Enum representing different types of notifications used for icon mapping and accessibility.

classes.name: NotificationDeeplink
classes.description: Enum representing different deeplink targets associated with notifications.
